quote_json: "variables contained in an array"
requirement: Array elements are variables accessible through computed indices.

quote_json: "all of the same type"
requirement: Every element of an array has the same element type.

quote_json: "number of indices associated with each array element"
requirement: An array's rank is the number of indices associated with each element.

quote_json: "rank of one"
requirement: An array of rank one is single-dimensional.

quote_json: "rank greater than one"
requirement: An array of rank greater than one is multidimensional.

quote_json: "an integral number greater than or equal to zero"
requirement: Each array dimension has an integral nonnegative length.

quote_json: "dimension lengths are not part of the type"
requirement: Dimension lengths do not participate in the array type.

quote_json: "established when an instance of the array type is created"
requirement: Array instance creation establishes its dimension lengths at runtime.

quote_json: "from 0 to N \u2013 1 inclusive"
requirement: The valid indices of a dimension of length N are zero through N minus one inclusive.

quote_json: "product of the lengths of each dimension"
requirement: An array's element count equals the product of its dimension lengths.

quote_json: "one or more of the dimensions of an array have a length of zero"
requirement: An array is empty when any dimension has zero length.

quote_json: "element type of an array can itself be an array type"
requirement: An array can have an array element type.

quote_json: "distinct from multi-dimensional arrays"
requirement: Arrays of arrays are distinct from multidimensional arrays.

quote_json: "Every array type is a reference type"
requirement: Every array type is a reference type.

quote_json: "element type of an array can be any type"
requirement: An array may have any otherwise permitted element type, including value and array types.
notes: The ref struct exclusion is stated in E16-2-3-no-array-element, so this general wording does not remove that restriction. Source pointers: 8.2.

quote_json: "non_array_type followed by one or more rank_specifiers"
requirement: An array type can be written as a non-array type followed by one or more rank specifiers.

quote_json: "any type that is not itself an array_type"
requirement: A non_array_type is a type that is not an array type.

quote_json: "given by the leftmost rank_specifier"
requirement: An array type's rank is determined by its leftmost rank specifier.

quote_json: "one plus the number of \u201c,\u201d tokens"
requirement: A rank specifier denotes one plus its comma count as the array rank.

quote_json: "deleting the leftmost rank_specifier"
requirement: Removing the leftmost rank specifier from an array type yields its element type.

quote_json: "can be null"
requirement: An array-typed value may be null.

quote_json: "a reference to an instance of that array type"
requirement: An array-typed value may reference an instance of that array type.
notes: Covariant instance values are governed by 17.6.

quote_json: "abstract base type of all array types"
requirement: System.Array is the abstract base class of all array types.

quote_json: "from any array type to System.Array"
requirement: An array type has an implicit reference conversion to System.Array.

quote_json: "any interface type implemented by System.Array"
requirement: An array type has an implicit reference conversion to an interface implemented by System.Array.

quote_json: "from System.Array"
requirement: System.Array has an explicit reference conversion to any array type.

quote_json: "any interface type implemented by System.Array to any array type"
requirement: An interface implemented by System.Array has an explicit reference conversion to any array type.

quote_json: "not itself an array_type"
requirement: System.Array is a class type rather than an array type.

quote_json: "can be null"
requirement: A System.Array value may be null.

quote_json: "reference to an instance of any array type"
requirement: A System.Array value may reference an instance of any array type.

quote_json: "T[] implements the interface System.Collections.Generic.IList<T>"
requirement: A single-dimensional T array implements IList<T>.

quote_json: "and its base interfaces"
requirement: A single-dimensional T array implements IList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "implicit conversion from T[] to IList<T>"
requirement: A single-dimensional T array implicitly converts to IList<T>.

quote_json: "implicit conversion from T[] to IList<T> and its base interfaces"
requirement: A single-dimensional T array implicitly converts to IList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "if there is an implicit reference conversion from S to T"
requirement: If S implicitly reference-converts to T, S[] implements IList<T>.

quote_json: "implicit reference conversion from S[] to IList<T>"
requirement: If S implicitly reference-converts to T, S[] implicitly reference-converts to IList<T>.

quote_json: "IList<T> and its base interfaces"
requirement: Under the same element reference conversion, S[] implicitly reference-converts to IList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "If there is an explicit reference conversion from S to T"
requirement: If S explicitly reference-converts to T, S[] explicitly reference-converts to IList<T>.

quote_json: "explicit reference conversion from S[] to IList<T> and its base interfaces"
requirement: Under the same explicit element reference conversion, S[] explicitly reference-converts to IList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "also implements the interface System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<T>"
requirement: A single-dimensional T array implements IReadOnlyList<T>.

quote_json: "and its base interfaces"
requirement: A single-dimensional T array implements IReadOnlyList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "implicit conversion from T[] to IReadOnlyList<T>"
requirement: T[] implicitly converts to IReadOnlyList<T>.

quote_json: "IReadOnlyList<T> and its base interfaces"
requirement: T[] implicitly converts to IReadOnlyList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "S[] implements IReadOnlyList<T>"
requirement: If S implicitly reference-converts to T, S[] implements IReadOnlyList<T>.

quote_json: "implicit reference conversion from S[] to IReadOnlyList<T>"
requirement: If S implicitly reference-converts to T, S[] implicitly reference-converts to IReadOnlyList<T>.

quote_json: "IReadOnlyList<T> and its base interfaces"
requirement: Under the same element reference conversion, S[] implicitly reference-converts to IReadOnlyList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "If there is an explicit reference conversion from S to T"
requirement: If S explicitly reference-converts to T, S[] explicitly reference-converts to IReadOnlyList<T>.

quote_json: "explicit reference conversion from S[] to IReadOnlyList<T> and its base interfaces"
requirement: Under the same explicit element reference conversion, S[] explicitly reference-converts to IReadOnlyList<T>'s base interfaces.

quote_json: "explicit reference conversion from IList<T>"
requirement: If S[] has an implicit or explicit reference conversion to IList<T>, IList<T> explicitly reference-converts to S[].

quote_json: "and its base interfaces to S[]"
requirement: Under the same condition, IList<T>'s base interfaces explicitly reference-convert to S[].

quote_json: "some of the members of the implemented interface may throw exceptions"
requirement: An array's IList<T> implementation may throw exceptions from some interface members.

quote_json: "precise behavior of the implementation of the interface is beyond the scope"
requirement: The precise behavior of an array's IList<T> implementation is outside this standard's specification.
notes: Classified as unspecified because the source supplies no required behavior or implementation-documentation obligation.

quote_json: "created by array_creation_expressions"
requirement: Array instances may be created by array creation expressions.

quote_json: "field or local variable declarations that include an array_initializer"
requirement: A field declaration with an array initializer may create an array instance.

quote_json: "local variable declarations that include an array_initializer"
requirement: A local-variable declaration with an array initializer may create an array instance.

quote_json: "created implicitly as part of evaluating an argument list"
requirement: An argument list involving a parameter array may implicitly create an array instance.

quote_json: "rank and length of each dimension are established"
requirement: Creation establishes an array instance's rank for its entire lifetime.

quote_json: "remain constant for the entire lifetime"
requirement: Creation fixes an array instance's dimension lengths for its entire lifetime.

quote_json: "always of an array type"
requirement: Every array instance has an array type.

quote_json: "abstract type that cannot be instantiated"
requirement: System.Array itself cannot be instantiated.

quote_json: "always initialized to their default value"
requirement: Array creation expressions initially initialize array elements to their default values.
notes: Explicit initializer assignments are separately stated in 17.7; this rule does not assert their final values are default. Source pointers: 9.3.

quote_json: "of the form A[I1, I2, ..., Ix]"
requirement: An array element access consists of an array expression followed by a bracketed index list.

quote_json: "expression of type int, uint, long, ulong"
requirement: An array index may have type int.

quote_json: "expression of type int, uint, long, ulong"
requirement: An array index may have type uint.

quote_json: "expression of type int, uint, long, ulong"
requirement: An array index may have type long.

quote_json: "expression of type int, uint, long, ulong"
requirement: An array index may have type ulong.

quote_json: "implicitly converted to one or more of these types"
requirement: An array index may have a type implicitly convertible to int, uint, long or ulong.

quote_json: "result of an array element access is a variable"
requirement: An array element access yields the variable selected by its indices.

quote_json: "enumerated using a foreach statement"
requirement: An array's elements can be enumerated with foreach.

quote_json: "inherits the members declared by the System.Array type"
requirement: Every array type inherits System.Array's declared members.

quote_json: "an implicit reference conversion"
requirement: If reference type A implicitly reference-converts to reference type B, A[R] implicitly reference-converts to B[R] with the same rank specifier.

quote_json: "explicit reference conversion"
requirement: If reference type A explicitly reference-converts to reference type B, A[R] explicitly reference-converts to B[R] with the same rank specifier.

quote_json: "reference to an instance of an array type B[R]"
requirement: An A[R] value may reference a B[R] instance when B implicitly reference-converts to A.

quote_json: "assignments to elements of reference type arrays include a run-time check"
requirement: Storing into a reference-type array checks at runtime that the value is permitted by the actual array element type.

quote_json: "does not extend to arrays of value_types"
requirement: Array covariance cannot be applied to an array of a value type.

quote_json: "specified in field declarations"
requirement: A field declaration may contain an array initializer.

quote_json: "local variable declarations"
requirement: A local-variable declaration may contain an array initializer.

quote_json: "array creation expressions"
requirement: An array creation expression may contain an array initializer.

quote_json: "'{' variable_initializer_list? '}'"
requirement: An array initializer may enclose an optional variable-initializer list in braces.

quote_json: "'{' variable_initializer_list ',' '}'"
requirement: An array initializer may put a trailing comma after its nonempty variable-initializer list.

quote_json: "variable_initializer (',' variable_initializer)*"
requirement: A variable-initializer list contains one or more comma-separated variable initializers.

quote_json: "expression"
requirement: A variable initializer may be an expression.

quote_json: "array_initializer"
requirement: A variable initializer may be an array initializer.

quote_json: "array type immediately precedes the initializer"
requirement: An explicitly typed array creation expression supplies the initializer's array type.

quote_json: "inferred from the expressions in the array initializer"
requirement: An implicitly typed array creation expression infers its array type from the initializer expressions.

quote_json: "type of the field or variable being declared"
requirement: In a field or variable declaration, the declared field or variable type supplies the initializer's array type.

quote_json: "shorthand for an equivalent array creation expression"
requirement: An array initializer in a field or variable declaration is shorthand for the equivalent array creation expression.

quote_json: "shall consist of a sequence of expressions"
requirement: A single-dimensional array initializer must consist of expressions rather than nested array initializers.

quote_json: "each having an implicit conversion to the element type"
requirement: Every single-dimensional array initializer expression must implicitly convert to the array's element type.

quote_json: "increasing order, starting with the element at index zero"
requirement: Initializer expressions initialize successive elements in increasing index order starting at zero.

quote_json: "number of expressions in the array initializer determines the length"
requirement: The number of single-dimensional initializer expressions determines the created array's length.

quote_json: "as many levels of nesting as there are dimensions"
requirement: A multidimensional initializer's nesting depth must equal the array's rank.

quote_json: "outermost nesting level corresponds to the leftmost dimension"
requirement: Initializer nesting levels correspond in order to array dimensions from outermost/leftmost to innermost/rightmost.

quote_json: "number of elements at the corresponding nesting level"
requirement: The initializer's element count at each nesting level determines that dimension's length.

quote_json: "number of elements shall be the same"
requirement: Nested initializers at the same level must contain the same number of elements.

quote_json: "subsequent dimensions are assumed to also have length zero"
requirement: When a non-rightmost initializer dimension has zero length, all following dimensions also have zero length.

quote_json: "lengths shall be constant expressions"
requirement: An array creation expression with explicit lengths and an initializer must use constant dimension lengths.

quote_json: "number of elements at each nesting level shall match"
requirement: Each initializer nesting level's element count must match its explicitly specified dimension length.
